# Stock Management App - Instructions Copilot

## Stack Technology
- **Frontend**: React 18 + Vite
- **Backend**: Node.js + Express
- **Database**: PostgreSQL
- **Auth**: JWT tokens

## Project Structure
```
.
├── frontend/           # React app
├── backend/            # Express API
├── .github/
└── README.md
```

## Setup Progress

- [x] Project structure created
- [x] Backend initialized (Node.js/Express)
- [x] Frontend initialized (React/Vite)
- [x] Database schema setup
- [x] Stock management features (Entrées/Sorties, Historique, Recherche)
- [x] Complete UI with responsive design
- [ ] Testing and validation (À faire après démarrage)

## Key Features
- Add/Remove stock items
- Track entries and exits
- Detailed history with user info
- Real-time search and filters
- Responsive UI

## Development

### Backend
```bash
cd backend
npm install
npm run dev
```

### Frontend
```bash
cd frontend
npm install
npm run dev
```

## Database Setup
PostgreSQL configuration in `backend/.env`
